meta_title: PTZ Locksmith & Secure | Emergency Locksmith Bristol
meta_description: PTZ Locksmith & Secure in Bristol. Emergency lockout, lock repair, and security solutions. Fast response, local family business. Call now for help.
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or car? Our team arrives within 30 minutes across Bristol and responds round the clock.
services_heading: Locksmith Services Across Bristol & South Gloucestershire
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to security upgrades, we handle every lock issue quickly and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Lockout
services.desc: Locked out of your home, office, or car? We'll have you back inside within 30 minutes, any time of day or night, with minimal damage to your property.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken or jammed locks repaired on the spot or replaced with high-security alternatives. We fit locks that last and keep you safe.

services.title: Burglary Repairs
services.desc: Fast emergency attendance and professional repairs after a break-in. We secure your property immediately and advise on upgrades to prevent it happening again.

services.title: Security Upgrades
services.desc: We assess your home or business and recommend locks, bolts, and hinges that genuinely improve security without breaking the bank.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: On-site key cutting for residential, commercial, and specialist keys. Get spares made while you wait at a fair price.

services.title: Door & Window Locks
services.desc: Professional fitting of new locks, sliding bolts, and window locks. We work with doors of all types — timber, composite, UPVC, and aluminium.

about_pullquote: We answer at midnight like we answer at noon — no judgement, fair price, sorted fast.
about_para_1: PTZ Locksmith & Secure has been looking after Bristol homes and businesses for over 18 years. We started because we were fed up seeing neighbours charged extortionate fees and left waiting hours in a panic. Today we're known for honest pricing, rapid response, and work that's done properly the first time.
about_para_2: We're local, we're here 24/7, and we don't charge a call-out fee. Whether you're locked out at 2am or need a security overhaul, you'll speak to a real locksmith who knows Bristol inside out. Our customers come back because we're reliable, fair, and we actually listen to what you need.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Got locked out on a Friday night and honestly thought I'd be stuck outside till morning. Called PTZ and they were here in 20 minutes. Sorted it without any fuss, didn't charge the earth, and were really friendly about the whole thing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had my front door lock replaced and they talked me through what would actually make a difference to security rather than just trying to sell me the most expensive option. Fair pricing and brilliant workmanship. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Helen K.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out after a break-in. They came quickly, got the door secure, and gave really sensible advice on next steps. Made a horrible situation way less stressful. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Dave P.
